## 中文原文

你周末和朋友一起去商场逛街，先在几家服装店随便逛了逛，试了几件衣服但没买。之后你们去电影院看了一部刚上映的喜剧片，电影很搞笑，看得很轻松。看完电影在商场楼下买了两杯奶茶，边喝边聊，然后一起回家了。

## English translation

I hung out with my friend at the mall over the weekend.

We browsed a few clothing stores and tried on some outfits, but didn’t end up buying anything.

After that, we went to watch a newly released comedy at the cinema. It was really funny and super relaxing.

Once the movie finished, we grabbed two cups of milk tea on the ground floor of the mall. We chatted while sipping our drinks, then headed home together.
